source_qualified_findings: GitHub repository-content updates require the blob SHA of the file being replaced; this supplies a stale-write/CAS guard for role-local state transport: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents

GitHub REST capacity is governed by resettable rate-limit windows such as per-hour limits rather than a monthly compute/storage allowance: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api

GitHub recommends serial requests and stopping until reset after rate-limit errors, which is compatible with checkpoint-and-return rather than same-run polling: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/using-the-rest-api/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api

Commit role-local state with predecessor blob SHA as a CAS guard and exact-read back before normal return.
Resume from durable state next invocation; use an effect identity derived from task, predecessor state and leaf identity to reject duplicate replay.
